name: MultiSelect
description: Searchable multi-select filter with visible removable chips and a checkbox panel.
designIntent: Dashboard filters need to show the selected set without opening the control. MultiSelect pairs a searchable checkbox panel with chips outside the trigger, so the applied filters stay visible and removable.

props.name: options
props.description: Options to choose from: value, label, optional description, group and disabled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires with the full selection after every change.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible field label; also names the trigger.

props.name: triggerLabel
props.description: Trigger text when nothing is selected.

props.name: maxDisplay
props.description: Maximum chips shown before a +N more summary.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disable the trigger and chip removal.

examples.title: Industry filter
examples.code:
<MultiSelect
  label="Industry"
  value={industries}
  onValueChange={setIndustries}
  options={[
    { value: 'technology', label: 'Technology' },
    { value: 'healthcare', label: 'Healthcare' },
  ]}
/>
examples.description: Selected industries stay visible as chips.

antiPatterns.title: Don't put the chips inside the trigger
antiPatterns.explanation: Chips carry remove buttons; nesting them in the trigger button creates invalid controls and conflicting click targets.
antiPatterns.example: // MultiSelect renders chips above the trigger by design.

accessibility.implementation: The trigger is named by the visible label and exposes aria-haspopup=dialog and aria-expanded
accessibility.userRequirements: Provide a label that names the filter category

accessibility.implementation: Options are native checkbox inputs with wrapping labels
Each chip has a Remove <option> button
accessibility.userRequirements: Do not remove the only way to clear the selection; Select all and Clear remain in the panel

compositionRules.relationship: Place MultiSelect inside a FilterPanel section
AppliedFilters summarizes the same state outside the panel
